name: alert-dialog
title: Alert Dialog
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Alert Dialog: a 3px case that pops in over three steps (flash adds a halo of concentration lines, off by default), over the light screentone veil from base. Action and Cancel are drawn as manga buttons; the action hits on click (tone="destructive" for irreversible actions).
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/alert-dialog". It wraps your own components/ui/alert-dialog, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A case that pops in over a screentone veil.
meta.usage:
import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle, AlertDialogTrigger } from "@/components/ui/manga/alert-dialog"

<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialogTrigger>Delete volume</AlertDialogTrigger>
  <AlertDialogContent>
    <AlertDialogHeader>
      <AlertDialogTitle>Delete Vol. 3?</AlertDialogTitle>
      <AlertDialogDescription>This cannot be undone.</AlertDialogDescription>
    </AlertDialogHeader>
    <AlertDialogFooter>
      <AlertDialogCancel>Keep</AlertDialogCancel>
      <AlertDialogAction tone="destructive">Delete</AlertDialogAction>
    </AlertDialogFooter>
  </AlertDialogContent>
</AlertDialog>

props.name: flash
props.description: On AlertDialogContent: a halo of concentration lines around the window as it opens.
